items.question: Which airport do Emirates and its low-cost partner FlyDubai fly from and to in the UAE?
items.fact: Emirates and FlyDubai operate from Dubai International Airport.

items.question: Which neighbouring countries can be reached by road from the UAE?
items.gold: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) and the Sultanate of Oman.
items.fact: UAE roads connect to Saudi Arabia and Oman.
